ValidationRule.description: Visitor cases should have status as Resolved Without Resolution and should have resolution comments
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Case_Validation_Bypass__c.Bypass_Validation__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Status ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseType__c, 'Visitor Case'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseType__c, 'Visitor Case'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed with Service Request') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseType__c, 'Visitor Case'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed with Service Request') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseType__c, 'Visitor Case'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed without Resolution'), ISBLANK(Resolution_Comments__c) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Visitor cases should have status as Closed Without Resolution and should have resolution comments
